title: Presentation-cokernel module descent data
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, F:I→CommRing a diagram of local rings with local maps, and c its ring-colimit cocone with local maps and local vertex A. Let τ:A→T be local with T local. Let N be a T-module with a specified presentation N≅T^t/im(H), where H:T^s→T^t is linear and s,t are natural numbers. Fix i₀∈I, a local-ring diagram B on I≥i₀ with local transitions and ring-colimit cocone β to T with local legs, maps κᵢ=βᵢ, and local essentially finite type maps τᵢ:F(i)→B(i) satisfying κᵢτᵢ=τcᵢ and bⱼᵢτᵢ=τⱼFⱼᵢ. Assume that the canonical ring maps B(i)⊗_{F(i)}F(j)→B(j), x⊗y↦bⱼᵢ(x)τⱼ(y), for i≤j, and B(i)⊗_{F(i)}A→T, x⊗y↦κᵢ(x)τ(y), for all i, are localizations at multiplicative submonoids. Then there exists i₁≥i₀. Restrict B, β, κ and τᵢ to I≥i₁ along ρ(i)=(i,i₀≤i₁≤i), writing B₁=ρ*B and κ₁=ρ*κ. On that later tail there exist an additive-group diagram D and cocone δ to N with additive colimit N, maps νᵢ equal to δᵢ, and B₁(i)-module structures on D(i). They satisfy νᵢ(yx)=κ₁ᵢ(y)νᵢ(x), and each transition dⱼᵢ is semilinear over bⱼᵢ. Each D(i) is finite and is isomorphic to B₁(i)^t/im(Hᵢ) for a B₁(i)-linear map Hᵢ:B₁(i)^s→B₁(i)^t. For every i≤j in I≥i₁ there is a B₁(j)-linear equivalence B₁(j)⊗_{B₁(i)}D(i)≅D(j) sending y⊗x to y·dⱼᵢ(x). For every i in I≥i₁ there is a T-linear equivalence T⊗_{B₁(i)}D(i)≅N sending y⊗x to y·νᵢ(x). No module data is asserted on the old tail before i₁; ring localization properties are assumptions, not additional conclusions. Terminology: ring-colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], finitely presented algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], essentially finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra], and finite module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].

source.place: Algebra, Lemmas 00QX and 00R1, construction of cokernels of descended presentation matrices

proof.text: Apply Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep to each entry of LinearMap.toMatrix' H in the old tail ring colimit. Finset induction and directedness give one stage k carrying every entry (the empty matrix uses nonemptiness). Let i₁=k.val and ρ be the inclusion of I≥i₁ into I≥i₀. The tail is nonempty and directed. A common upper bound with k gives a morphism from every old-tail object; the thin-category condition gives ρ.Final by Functor.final_of_exists_of_isFiltered. Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv transports the given ring colimit to B₁=ρ⋙B.

Use the supplied presentation equivalence to define the surjective map f:T^t→N and prove Function.Exact H f. Transport the lifted matrix along B₁ from its least index. For each j form the actual quotient Q(j)=B₁(j)^t/range(A(j).toLin'). Define coordinates and prove coordinates_matrix by expanding the finite sums. Submodule.liftQ gives the semilinear maps on Q and the legs to N. Since the stage quotient lives in universe u, it is automatically Small in max u v; use the proved Shrink.linearEquiv to transport Q, its action, its quotient projection, and all maps to that universe. Equality on the surjective quotient projections proves identities, composition, cocone naturality and scalar compatibility. The standard finite-free and quotient Module.Finite instances give finiteness. The inverse Shrink equivalence explicitly supplies the prescribed s-by-t presentation at each stage.

The private presentation_baseChange proof applies IsBaseChange.of_right_exact to the quotient exact sequence and its transported finite-free presentation. IsBaseChange.linearMap and finitePow give the two free-term base changes; coordinates_matrix and the quotient-projection formulas give the commuting squares. Apply this once to a transition quotient and once to the given presentation f,H over T. IsBaseChange.comp_equiv transports through the source Shrink equivalence, and equiv_tmul proves the exact pure-tensor formulas in both requested comparisons.

Apply Module.baseChange_diagram_elementwise to B₁, the restricted ring colimit, the constructed D and δ, and the scalar and tensor comparison formulas. It supplies representatives in N and eventual zero for each stage element. Subtract two representatives after moving to a common upper bound and apply eventual zero to obtain eventual equality. For any additive cocone, choose a representative of each element of N and send it along its leg; eventual equality proves independence of representatives. Move representatives to a common stage to prove addition; the representative formula proves zero, factorization, and uniqueness. This explicitly constructs the additive IsColimit. Finally set ν(i)=(δ.app i).hom and use ring-hom extensionality on hκ to rewrite the cocone ring maps as κ₁, including their induced Algebra structures. The original signature and all its local-ring and ring-localization assumptions are retained, although the module construction needs only the supplied ring colimit.

theorem exists_limit_module_presentation_cokernel_data
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    [∀ i : I, IsLocalRing (F.obj i)] [IsLocalRing c.pt]
    (hF : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
    (hcLocal : ∀ i : I, IsLocalHom (c.ι.app i).hom)
    (T : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsLocalRing T] (τ : c.pt →+* T) [IsLocalHom τ]
    (N : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) [Module T N]
    (s t : ℕ) (H : (Fin s → T) →ₗ[T] (Fin t → T))
    (hN : Nonempty (((Fin t → T) ⧸ LinearMap.range H) ≃ₗ[T] N))
    (i₀ : I) (B : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (β : B ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj T)
    (hβcol : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk T β)))
    (hBlocal : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, IsLocalRing (B.obj i))
    (hβlocal : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, IsLocalHom (β.app i).hom)
    (hBmaplocal : ∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
      IsLocalHom (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
    (κ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, B.obj i →+* T)
    (hκ : ∀ i x, κ i x = (β.app i).hom x)
    (τ₀ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, F.obj i.1 →+* B.obj i)
    (hτlocal : ∀ i, IsLocalHom (τ₀ i))
    (hτfinite : ∀ i, (τ₀ i).EssFiniteType)
    (hτcomp : ∀ i, (κ i).comp (τ₀ i) = τ.comp (c.ι.app i.1).hom)
    (hτnat : ∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
      (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.comp (τ₀ i) =
        (τ₀ j).comp (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
    (hRingTrans : ∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
      letI := (τ₀ i).toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
      (∃ φ : B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] F.obj j.1 →+* B.obj j,
        (∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : F.obj j.1),
          φ (x ⊗ₜ[F.obj i.1] y) =
            (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * τ₀ j y) ∧
        (letI := φ.toAlgebra
         ∃ U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] F.obj j.1),
           IsLocalization U (B.obj j))))
    (hRingLimit : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i},
      letI := (τ₀ i).toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra (F.obj i.1) c.pt := (c.ι.app i.1).hom.toAlgebra
      (∃ φ : B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] c.pt →+* T,
        (∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : c.pt),
          φ (x ⊗ₜ[F.obj i.1] y) = κ i x * τ y) ∧
        (letI := φ.toAlgebra
         ∃ U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] c.pt), IsLocalization U T))) :
  ∃ (i₁ : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i₁),
  let ρ : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i} ⥤ {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} :=
    { obj := fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, hi.trans i.2⟩
      map := fun h ↦ homOfLE (leOfHom h) }
  let B₁ := ρ ⋙ B
  let κ₁ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i}, B₁.obj i →+* T := fun i ↦ κ (ρ.obj i)
  ∃ (D : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) (δ : D ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj N),
  Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk N δ)) ∧
  ∃ (ν : ∀ i : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i}, D.obj i →+ N)
    (_ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i}, Module (B₁.obj i) (D.obj i)),
    (∀ i, ∀ x : D.obj i, ν i x = (δ.app i).hom x) ∧
    (∀ i, ∀ (y : B₁.obj i) (x : D.obj i), ν i (y • x) = κ₁ i y • ν i x) ∧
    (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j)
      (y : B₁.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
      (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom (y • x) =
        (B₁.map (homOfLE h)).hom y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
    (∀ i, Module.Finite (B₁.obj i) (D.obj i)) ∧
    (∀ i, ∃ H₀ : (Fin s → B₁.obj i) →ₗ[B₁.obj i] (Fin t → B₁.obj i),
      Nonempty (((Fin t → B₁.obj i) ⧸ LinearMap.range H₀) ≃ₗ[B₁.obj i] D.obj i)) ∧
    (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
      (letI := (B₁.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
       ∃ e : B₁.obj j ⊗[B₁.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[B₁.obj j] D.obj j,
         ∀ (y : B₁.obj j) (x : D.obj i),
           e (y ⊗ₜ[B₁.obj i] x) = y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x)) ∧
    (∀ i : {i : I // i₁ ≤ i},
      (letI := (κ₁ i).toAlgebra
       ∃ e : T ⊗[B₁.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[T] N,
         ∀ (y : T) (x : D.obj i), e (y ⊗ₜ[B₁.obj i] x) = y • ν i x))
